method: Independent second-author cross-review of all 128 exact existing Spec proposals, read with the selected English source sense/hash and every retained Spanish semantic sense in four batches of 32. Approval accepts the unchanged proposed meaningIndex, record hash, frame, profile and context; only aspectModes may be restricted to the stated subset. Prior different choices remain archival and their notes are not imported. This is original model linguistic judgment, not source-membership-only approval, native-human certification or a rendered-word coverage claim. Ordinary permits source-supported human agents/operators/patients and genuine personal figuratives; entity-only selected contexts require it-only rather than invented human personification. Mandatory pronominal substitutions, incompatible subject roles and resultative/middle-slot failures are withheld. Ordinary context-supplied trailing complements and grammatical word-level fragments are not rejected merely for lacking a full example sentence. Exact hyphenated/base frames remain subject to existing verified inflection guards; no qualified English past/participle override is supplied. No application/source edits or publication.

rejected.reason: Lull to sleep requires an intervening sleeper/patient in English; unchanged bare frame can lose the causative role. Needs an explicitly reviewed patient-bearing construction.

Selected context explicitly makes excessive heat the drying/scorching agent. Ordinary I/we parched is not supported by that selected sense; require it-only or separately reviewed human-causer evidence.
Proposal expressly selects rain/water forming channels and excludes a person forming them. Ordinary conflicts with that entity-agent context; require it-only.
Selected context makes cold the causal agent. Ordinary human numbing-with-cold needs separately reviewed operator evidence or a revised restricted profile; retain defective-paradigm safeguards.
Selected context/notes make things correspond or harmonize; unrestricted human correspondence could mean exchanging messages. Require it-only or exact human-compatible sense evidence.
Proposal explicitly makes an event/fact the recorded subject. Ordinary I was on record introduces a human-speaker reading not selected here; require it-only.
Selected source explicitly concerns water or a thing proceeding from another. Ordinary human stem-from clauses are not established by this sense; require it-only or reviewed personal-origin evidence.
Selected context is fruit beginning to take ripe color. Ordinary human subjects would borrow a different metaphor; require it-only.

Proposal explicitly makes a body part the subject of smarting. Ordinary I was smarting can introduce emotional or whole-person sensation outside the selected context; require it-only or a separately reviewed personal sense.
Selected context/notes explicitly make a vessel the listing subject, not a human operator. Require it-only rather than unrestricted I/we list.

Selected poetic blazing/light-emission reading does not independently establish unrestricted human subjects. Narrow the literal flame/light profile to it-only or provide a separately reviewed human-compatible sense.

Selected frame is an intransitive flame-emitting subject, expressly excluding human waving/sterilizing actions. Require it-only or separate literal human usage evidence; do not borrow other flamear senses.
Unchanged context is producing flowers, not the distinct musical or persuasive human senses. Require a plant/entity it-only profile.
Selected source and context concern emitting lightning or trembling light. Require it-only for the literal light-emitting entity; unqualified human flash would introduce other senses.
Context is a vessel involuntarily dragging its anchor. Ordinary I drag anchor may introduce a person deliberately pulling it; require it-only or separately reviewed conventional crew construction.
Selected context explicitly makes an animal use its snout. Require it-only; human digging with a stick or kissing is a different unselected sense.
Selected intransitive emitting-flames context supports the burning entity, not an unrestricted human fire-setter. Require it-only or exact personal literal usage evidence.

Resultative set-to-music requires an intervening text/patient to preserve the causative role in English. Needs a reviewed explicit patient construction or a different source-supported frame such as musicalise.
Bare roll into a ball makes the subject undergo curling, contradicting the proposed transitive maker context. Needs a reviewed intervening patient construction or different causative frame.

Exact look at again places again after a preposition whose object is absent, yielding malformed I looked at again. A revised frame such as look again at would require explicit cross-review rather than silent reordering.
Selected context explicitly makes a plant produce new shoots. Require it-only; the separate recurrence sense cannot authorize human sprouting.
Exact context makes a wound/bodily site produce pus. Require it-only or separately reviewed whole-person usage, rather than ordinary I/we produce pus.
Spanish selected definition makes a sounding thing produce a buzz/whir. Require it-only or exact human sound-production evidence; do not infer human imitation.
